skill: Surgical / Maritime Square Knot Tying & Capsize Prevention

knowledge_package.title: Reef (Square) Knot Dual-Throw Topology & Anti-Granny Rule
knowledge_package.summary: Binding two rope ends by crossing Right-over-Left followed by Left-over-Right to form symmetrical interlocking bights that lock under tension.

claims.statement: Cross active working end right-over-left and wrap under once to create the foundational half-knot.
The second throw must cross Left-over-Right (the exact reverse of throw 1). Repeating right-over-left produces an unstable Granny Knot.

rubric.title: Square Knot Bight Topology & Tensile Lock Rubric
rubric.description: Deterministic scoring of throw crossing sequence, bight symmetry, and capsize resistance under 20N load.

criteria.name: First throw overhand orientation (Right-over-Left)
criteria.description: First half-knot correctly crossed and dressed flat.
criteria.observable_indicator: Right cord wraps under left cord with even tail lengths.

criteria.name: Second throw reversal (Left-over-Right Anti-Granny Rule)
criteria.description: Second throw reverses crossing direction so both working ends emerge parallel.
criteria.observable_indicator: Working ends exit through same bight parallel to standing ends.

criteria.name: Tensile load locking test (zero slip at 20N)
criteria.description: Knot tightens uniformly when standing ends pulled; does not capsize into slip knot.
criteria.observable_indicator: Zero knot displacement or untying under 20N bilateral tensile load.

practice_task.title: Tie True Square Knot Under Tension Load
practice_task.instructions: Tie two colored 10mm marine lines into a true square knot. Dress the knot and pull standing ends to verify anti-capsize lock.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Second throw repeated Right-over-Left. Produced an asymmetric Granny knot with tails protruding perpendicular.
Under 12N tension, knot capsized into a slipping half-hitch and untied completely.

feedback.summary: Targeted corrective feedback for the next attempt.

items.what_was_observed: Threw Right-over-Left twice consecutively, creating a Granny Knot.
items.what_differed: Threw Right-over-Left twice consecutively, creating a Granny Knot.
items.corrective_advice: If throw #1 was Right-over-Left, throw #2 MUST be Left-over-Right. The working ends must exit parallel to the standing lines.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Second throw cleanly reversed (Left-over-Right); working ends exit strictly parallel.
Withstood 25N static tension with zero capsize or rope creep.

lineage.adaptation_notes: First-divergence crossing topology visualizer cleanly differentiated Square Knot from Granny Knot.
